name: Minntz | Zandy
description:
Zandy delivers a sweet candy-forward profile layered with creamy vanilla cake and finished with a smooth gas that lingers on the exhale. The flavor is rich yet balanced — dessert-like without being overpowering, with just enough gas to keep it grounded. Effects come on quick with a lifted, clear-headed high that settles into a relaxed body feel. It’s euphoric, smooth, and easy to stay functional - but perfect for zoning in without slowing down.

FLAVOR: Sweet Candy, Vanilla Extract, Cream, Gas
EFFECTS: Euphoric, Uplifted, Relaxed, Happy
